missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing requests to identify the internal 500 cause
Order service metrics (error rate, latency, dependency outcomes) during the incident window
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; gateway propagates this as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500, so the fault originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the 500 origin is bounded.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are caused by upstream order service returning 500 on /v1/orders, per correlated traces and client-request logs. The specific internal failure in order is not yet evidenced.
